channel.note: An IRC channel (#name): a chat room, not a TV or audio channel.

nick.note: The name a user goes by on IRC; it can change at any time.

server.note: An IRC server, one of the machines a network is made of.

network.note: An IRC network: the servers you connect to as one, with its own channels and users.

mention.note: A message that names you (your nick).

highlight.note: A message marked because it mentions you or matches one of your words.

ban.note: A channel or network ban that keeps a user out.

away.note: The status of a user who is not at the keyboard, set with /away.

topic.note: A channel topic: the line shown at the top of a channel.

account.note: A registered account on the network's services, which you log in to with SASL.

mode.note: An IRC mode (+o, +b, +i …) on a channel or a user.

bouncer.note: An IRC bouncer: a service that stays connected for you and keeps what you missed.

reaction.note: An emoji reaction to a message.

operator.note: An IRC operator (oper): a network administrator, or a channel operator when the text says so.

services.note: The network services (NickServ, ChanServ, X3 …) that keep accounts and channels.

notification.note: A system or push notification on the device.

notice.note: An IRC NOTICE message (a server notice, a notice to a user). Not a push notification: give it its own word.
